description: The second revision of the MARV flight computer, now final and in production at JLCPCB. An RP2354B flight controller for rockets and drones with an ICM-45686 IMU, an LSM6DSK320X ±320 g high-g IMU and a BMP581 barometer, each on its own bus with data-ready interrupts, plus four-bit microSD logging over PIO, USB-C, a separate sensor LDO and a plug-on 5 V converter. Every change traces back to a problem V1 showed in flight. Drag to explore the board in 3D.
